newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman stocks rise on back of bank, investment shares.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks rise on back of bank, investment shares.

text.p: Oman stocks extended gains in the week to Wednesday, with bank and investment stocks pushing up the index to 234.39 points from last week's 232.88 points, the exchange said.
The week's total trade value reached 27.11 million rials ($71 million) from 24.06 million rials, the Muscat Securities Market (MSM) said.
Some 9.29 million shares changed hands in 3023 deals compared with a previous 7.88 million shares.
Of the 63 companies traded, 33 rose, 16 were steady and 14 dropped.
Some 827,000 shares of al-Ahlia Portfolio worth 5.34 million rials changed hands, with the share closing at 6.830 rials from last week's 5.630 rials.
The banking and investment sectors accounted for 79 percent of the week's total trade value.
